title: Frost Walker Tweaker
description: This DataPack lets you use Frost Walker II while riding an entity.
body:
This light-weight super duper optimized datapack makes Frost Walker II work when you ride an entity. It's compatable with any rideable entity, even those added using mods, plugins or datapacks (aslong as it has a saddle slot).

This light-weight super duper optimized datapack has a super duper top secret feature, where riding a strider while having Frost Walker II shoes equiped will allow the strider to turn lava into basalt (It also works when the strider has leather shoes with Frost Walker IV and Vanishing Curse I equiped due to ummm).
